calendarNotes: KCPS lists August 24 as the first student day and May 28 as the last student day with early dismissal. The official Spring Break ends March 25, but students are also out March 26 for the Spring Holiday. calendarFaqs.q: When does Kansas City Public Schools start in 2026–27?
When do KCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a district professional-development day with no school, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When are KCPS students off for Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Spring Break runs March 22–25, 2027. March 26 is a separate Spring Holiday, so students are out March 22–26 and return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for KCPS seniors in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists Friday, April 30, 2027, as the seniors' last day. May 28 is the last day for all KCPS students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KCPS dismiss early on the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last day for students and an early-dismissal day. The annual PDF does not give one districtwide dismissal time, so families should check their school's schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KCPS publish Spanish and Swahili school calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Official Spanish and Swahili PDFs are linked in Downloads. Four reporting dates differ from the current English calendar, and their June 2027 grids contain date-number errors. This page follows the current English PDF and documents those differences.

The Spanish and Swahili June 2027 grids duplicate June 26 and June 28 and omit June 25 and June 27; the Spanish sidebar also prints ‘JULIIO.’
Student return dates and combined days-off ranges are derived from the sequence of dates in the official schedule without renaming the underlying KCPS events.
